definitions.explanation: Describing an attitude, project, or goal that pushes boundaries and embraces difficulty.
Describing behavior, a look, or an attitude that deliberately provokes or challenges someone.

examples.japanese: {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{目標|もくひょう}を{立|た}てた。
この{企画|きかく}は{非常|ひじょう}に{挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{内容|ないよう}だ。
examples.english: This project has very ambitious content.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}たちが{挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}なテーマに{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: Young researchers are tackling challenging themes.

examples.japanese: {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{態度|たいど}を{取|と}る。
{彼|かれ}は{挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{目|め}つきでこちらを{見|み}た。
examples.english: He looked at us with a provocative gaze.

examples.japanese: {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}で{挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{発言|はつげん}をして{物議|ぶつぎ}を{醸|かも}した。
examples.english: A provocative remark at the press conference stirred controversy.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from {挑戦|ちょうせん} (challenge) plus {的|てき}. The two senses reflect the dual nature of {挑戦|ちょうせん} itself — it can mean undertaking a difficult challenge (positive) or confronting someone aggressively (negative).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{目標|もくひょう}: challenging goal
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{態度|たいど}: defiant attitude
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{取|と}り{組|く}み: ambitious initiative
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{姿勢|しせい}: challenging stance
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な{目|め}つき: provocative look

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {意欲的|いよくてき}: ambitious; motivated — positive connotation only, without the provocative nuance
- {攻撃的|こうげきてき}: aggressive; offensive — stronger hostility than the confrontational sense of {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}
- {野心的|やしんてき}: ambitious — focuses on aspiration and grand scale rather than difficulty
